spatial.preconditions: Explicit exhaustive nonnegative category cardinalities, supported category layout, positive spatial width.
spatial.missing_value_behavior: Reject; never infer missing category as zero.
spatial.output_units: count per artificial area; display coordinates
spatial.uncertainty_effect: No uncertainty distribution inferred. Model alternatives remain separate.
spatial.known_information_loss: Geometry omits identity names, FIFO ordering, action details and all unencoded fields. These remain in the source resolver; byte recovery is separate from geometric inversion.

coverage.interpretation: Coverage proves retained source-node accountability, not semantic understanding or irrelevance of unused fields.

preservation.unused_and_unaligned: Retained unchanged; prior ledger use labels describe the prior trace viewer. Current named preset does not consume six sensor cases.
preservation.lifecycle: Optional and unimplemented; existing provisional segments remain source-linked and may overlap.

rendering_record.geometry: sampled 3D height mesh projected to Canvas2D

encoding.field_authority: supplied encoding.field(), no renderer analytical-kernel implementation

coordinate_roles.z: encoding.field() value multiplied by shared display gain

rendering_record.exact_values: supplied category weights are authoritative; rendered peaks are not exact category weights

finite_domain.crop_semantics: Field sampled only inside the declared square; outside values are not shown.

mesh.spatial_interpolation: projected quadrilateral faces between field samples
mesh.surface_face_culling: omit face only when all sampled vertex values < 0.004

geometry_cache.reason: identical deterministic spatial field inputs reuse geometry; source identities and provenance remain in caller records, never in the geometry cache

contours.algorithm: linear marching squares at sampled field values

style.solo_material: same teal base color, fill opacity, lighting, contour and section style for A and B; labels carry identity
style.opacity_purpose: spatial near-zero fade, never uncertainty or probability
style.contour_visibility: contours drawn over surfaces; possible through-surface visibility is a presentation cue

camera_limits.programmatic_behavior: reject nonfinite or out-of-range values; never silently clamp
camera_limits.gesture_behavior: pitch and zoom are clamped at the published limits

rendering_record.shared_calibration: A and B share encoding, kernel, gains, camera and coordinate roles. Side panes have equal dimensions.
rendering_record.fit_policy: Explicit Fit both only. Union of configured A+B, including hidden comparison in solo, plus reference plane, sampled geometry, axis and margin; changes only shared camera zoom/pan.
rendering_record.viewport_clipping: Reported separately by Scene.getClippingStatus(); no per-frame normalization or automatic fit.

history.native_time_field: time_s preserved by caller; never overwritten
history.carry_in: row_kind=carry_in: caller-selected state at display_time_s=window start, shown as a dashed boundary without an event marker; native time remains explicit
history.state_between_events: held between supplied ordered records only
history.same_time_events: same display coordinate; event order retained

actual_bounds.scope: configured A+B, including hidden solo comparison; side panels use their assigned body
actual_bounds.near_zero_render_culling: See mesh manifest; viewport clipping is a separate issue.

last_shared_fit.scope: union of configured A and B even in solo

replay_claims.source_bytes: Retained by referenced local artifacts; save file does not duplicate sources.
replay_claims.derived_values: Recomputed and checked against saved effective configuration on restore.
replay_claims.pixels: Not guaranteed across browsers, device pixel ratios, viewport or fonts.
